> Blog · Pipeliners · 2026-06-23

# Summary
One of the 6 posts published in the June 22-23 session. Sources: `blog-drafts\trenchless-sewer-repair.md`, `gutenberg\trenchless-sewer-repair.html`, `faq-schema\trenchless-sewer-repair-faqschema.html`, a featured image in `featured-img\`, and the merge plan `guardian-fixes-2026-10-09\4-sewer-line-repair-without-digging-MERGED-DRAFT.md`.

# Key facts
- **Focus keyword:** trenchless sewer repair. URL /trenchless-sewer-repair/ (post 15575).
- The June draft explains CIPP lining and pipe bursting; pipe bursting is not a Pipeliners service.
- **Merge (Oct 9):** the Company Master Profile says blogs must not target "trenchless sewer repair" (service pages own it). So the survivor is /repair-sewer-line-without-digging/ (post 15361, focus "sewer line repair without digging", 170/mo, KD 12, 25 inbound links), and 15575 was planned to 301 to it and be set to draft (not deleted). `fix-backups\2026-10-09_guardian-blogs\` holds after-state files for 15361 and a before-state for 15575, which indicates the merge was applied.
